english.meaning: to the highest degree; used after an adjective
english.note: 好極 means extremely good. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: For a third-rate artist, being able to do this is already damn good.
exampleSentences.traditional: 作為一個三流藝術家已經。能夠做到噉。好極𡃉嚹已經係。
